name: Serverless project API key
description: A personal API key created inside an Elastic Cloud Serverless project to call that project's Elasticsearch and Kibana APIs.

blockers.summary: Elastic describes one encoded representation and one response type for Elasticsearch and Serverless keys; only the issuance context differs.
Base64 alphabet, padding and part lengths would need an issued key, which is not created here.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
